actions_now: Avoid further top-dressing of nitrogen fertilizer.
Apply Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 5 g/L water foliar spray.
prevention: Seed treatment with Tricyclazole 75% WP @ 2 g/kg seed or Pseudomonas @ 10 g/kg seed.
Use blast resistant varieties (e.g. Swarna Sub1, IR64, CR Dhan series).
Split nitrogen fertilizer doses into 3-4 applications rather than heavy single doses.
text: Diagnosis: Rice - Blast. Severity: Mild. Immediate action: Avoid further top-dressing of nitrogen fertilizer.
